text:
alex_support: Customer reported intermittent partial responses from the /v1/stream endpoint, then immediate reconnects from their SDK. They say they see repeated charges for a single user session :confused:
eng-runtime: Can you paste the exact request + headers (esp. Authorization type, keep-alive, and proxy info)?
alex_support: Sent logs to thread: client behind corp-proxy, Authorization: Bearer (redacted), using our mobile SDK v1.4.2. Repro steps they gave:
```
1) open websocket-like HTTP stream: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-xl
2) after ~12s get partial JSON and connection closed
3) SDK auto-retries, new stream created, billing shows two sessions for same logical request
```
maria: Paste of server-side tail logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-02-11T14:32:22Z] conn=xyz writev: wrote 4096/16384 bytes, EAGAIN on fd 342
[2026-02-11T14:32:22Z] conn=xyz write error: EPIPE - client closed while flush
[2026-02-11T14:32:22Z] stream aborted: slow consumer, queued_bytes=245760, policy=abort
[2026-02-11T14:32:22Z] session end, reason=abort, tokens_generated=312
```
alex_support: So server is aborting because write buffer fills up and we detect slow consumer. Customer expects retries to resume same session (so they don't double-bill).
sam: On our side the SDK treats connection close as fatal and opens a new request (no idempotency token). That's expected for current SDK v1.4.2. We should not silently retry mid-stream.
oncall: Incident paging policy says if abort rate > 0.5% across a minute, page eng-runtime. Current metric is 0.8% for that cluster. Paging triggered.
eng-runtime: Quick triage: two possible root causes: 1) client-side slow reader (mobile backgrounding / small recv buffers / TCP stall) 2) upstream proxy (corporate proxy doing buffering/flush on idle). Both can make socket not drain and we hit our per-connection queue limit which triggers abort.
maria: Also seeing proxy headers: "Via: corp-proxy/1.12" and a chunked-encoding passthrough with keep-alive. Proxy has known bug where it coalesces small reads and delays sending, leading to bursts.
alex_support: Customer provided packet capture? They can only provide logs. They say Android app goes to background and re-opens stream on resume.
sam: That matches: mobile OS can pause reads, causing the TCP receive window to stall and the server's send buffer to fill. Our runtime's default behavior is to abort when queued_bytes > 200KB to protect memory.
oncall: For short-term mitigation we can bump per-connection threshold for that pool, but that increases memory risk.
billing-team: From billing side, we currently count tokens at end-of-session. If a session aborts after tokens_generated > 0 we mark it billable. If SDK creates a fresh session, that becomes another billable session. Customer-facing fix is to have the SDK attach an idempotency/session token so we can dedupe within a short window.
maria: Repro steps I ran from a slowed reader locally (tc qdisc netem  delay + packet-loss): reproduced EAGAIN then abort within ~10s. Command I used:
```
# simulate slow consumer on local machine
python -m http.server 8000 &
# run client that reads slowly (0.1KB/s)
stdbuf -o0 curl -N http://localhost:8000/stream | pv -L 100
```
alex_support: Customer asked for recommended SDK behavior now.
sam: Short term: implement client-side exponential backoff on reconnects and include a session-id header: X-Redwood-Stream-Session: <uuid>. On server side we can accept duplicate session starts for a grace window (30s) and mark duplicate sessions as resumable (no double-bill) if tokens_generated small and session_id matches.
eng-runtime: Longer-term: add a streaming idempotency token and server-side resume support for cases where client reconnects within 60s and provides last-acknowledged-token-index. This needs protocol work.
oncall: Ops action: increase abort threshold to 512KB for cluster cluster-eu-2 for 2 hours to reduce customer-visible aborts while we patch SDK. Creating change request.
maria: Note: increasing threshold will raise memory pressure; monitor payload_queued and OOMs. Set alert: queued_bytes_total > 50MB for cluster -> page.
billing-team: Also proposing a short grace billing policy: if duplicate sessions within 60s with same session-id, bill only first completed stream. We'll need legal sign-off.
alex_support: Action items for now:
- sam: ship SDK patch (session header + backoff) in v1.4.3, target tomorrow
- eng-runtime: enable cluster-eu-2 threshold bump for 2h and add monitor (oncall)
- billing-team: temporary dedupe policy + doc for support CPS
- maria: add a KB article 'Eventstream partial output from slow consumers' with repro + mitigation

sam: I'll open PR for SDK changes and attach a small migration note for customers.
eng-runtime: I'll roll the threshold change as a canary to 10% of hosts then 100% if stable.
oncall: Keep me updated if abort rate drops below 0.1% in the next 30m.
alex_support: Marking thread as escalated -> linked to ticket INC-2026-0543. Thanks all :thumbsup:
